assessments.reasoning: The project LICENSE at the cited commit identifies Jonathan Payne and JOVE. The complete notice is bytes [0,267), followed by a newline. The full hash matches the publisher revision in the claim. [Project LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonmacs/jove/adb660e55b395e536f3627fec45a8e353f388772/LICENSE)

The verified detail gives the exact lowercase ID jove and reproduces the entire project file in decoded licenseText. Deprecation and OSI approval are both false. The detail separately includes template, HTML and a project cross-reference through the 4_17 locator. [SPDX detail](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/json/details/jove.json)

The full pinned text has the same computed 268-byte length and SHA-256 as the publisher file, and both payloads are identical. [SPDX text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/text/jove.txt)

The annotated object gives v3.29.0 and commit target 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. Both jove URLs use that exact target and the case-sensitive identifier. The object is unsigned. [Annotated tag](https://api.github.com/repos/spdx/license-list-data/git/tags/76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b)

challenge.method: Compare ordered lowercase ASCII alphanumeric runs for the entire Jonathan Payne notice, verify full-string equality across the three payloads, test the date-range token boundary and check the final source-file and documentation condition. Verify both exact URL pins and the full capture hashes.
challenge.results: All three payloads are byte-identical and yield 43 tokens. Keeping the copyright year range as one token yields 42. The complete final condition is present in all three, with no additional publisher text outside the notice.

limitations: The comparison applies to the captured project notice and two representations generated from the same SPDX data revision. The captures establish SPDX deprecation status only within that revision. Index lifecycle assignments, broader legal conclusions, reuse and installation are outside scope.
reasoning: The exact jove membership record and the 43-token notice correspondence both reproduce against the data commit identified by the annotated release tag.
